Falcon gathering starts with road-test recording and stops with it. Stopping also removes the live matched path. Browsing the map does not upload a track.
Falcon trajectory correction
Use AMap Falcon to denoise and match driving tracks to roads. Enabling this uploads location tracks to AMap; raw points and dual-SIM measurements are kept separately.
No route import required. Cyan shows cloud corrections; signal-colored tracks retain raw positions. Driving roads are supported; railways and subways are not.

AMap Falcon driving correction collects every 2 seconds, syncs every 10 seconds and refreshes the last 3 minutes about every 15 seconds. Cyan shows the cloud road track. Delayed endpoints never replace your current position; raw locations remain available during outages. Railway and subway correction is not supported.
